evidence: Selecting "Priority" in Sort by combobox orders tasks High,High,High,Medium,Low (Review project proposal, Complete tax filing, Submit final report, Schedule dentist appointment, Buy groceries).

Selecting "Deadline" reorders list ascending by date: Buy groceries (Tomorrow), Review project proposal (Sep 4), Submit final report (Sep 7), Schedule dentist appointment (Sep 9), Complete tax filing (Sep 16).

issue: Edit fully disabled for tasks with incomplete prerequisites, contrary to spec
actual: Editing an unblocked task (Schedule dentist appointment) works correctly - description changed to "Updated via QA test." and priority changed to High, persisted after Save. However, per the app's own stated behavior, a task with an incomplete prerequisite (e.g. "QA Test Task", blocked by "Buy groceries") should still allow modification of description and priority fields. In practice the Edit button for such blocked tasks is fully disabled (disabled, pointer-events-none, opacity-50), so content/priority cannot be modified for "any task" as required - blocked tasks are entirely unmodifiable.

evidence: Clicked "Add Task", filled form, clicked "Create Task"; toast "Task created" appeared and "QA Test Task" was added to the active list, active count went from 5 to 6.

Create Task dialog accepted Title "QA Test Task", Description "This is a QA test task description.", and Deadline "2026-09-10" (native date input); all three were saved and displayed correctly on the created task card.
In the Create Task dialog, checked "Buy groceries" as a prerequisite for "QA Test Task"; the created task card displays "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete" confirming the binding was saved.

For "QA Test Task" (depends on incomplete "Buy groceries") the complete checkbox and edit button are disabled with cursor-not-allowed/opacity-50 styling, confirmed via DOM evaluate (disabled:true, classes include "cursor-not-allowed opacity-50"). Same for "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report" which depend on incomplete tasks.

Tasks with unmet single prerequisite show label e.g. "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" / "Prerequisite \"Buy groceries\" incomplete"; task with two unmet prerequisites ("Submit final report") shows "2 prerequisites incomplete".

Edit: modified "Schedule dentist appointment" description/priority, saved successfully. Complete: checked "Buy groceries" complete checkbox, it moved to Completed tab. Delete: deleted "Organize desk" via delete button, toast "Task deleted - \"Organize desk\" has been removed" and it disappeared from the list, completed count went from 3 to 2.
Clicking the complete checkbox on "Buy groceries" moved it out of Active list into Completed list; Active count decreased 6→5 and Completed count increased 2→3.
Default view on load shows "Active" tab selected, displaying only non-completed tasks with a live count (e.g. "Active 5"), separate from "Completed" tab.

"QA Test Task" (depends on "Buy groceries") had its complete checkbox disabled while "Buy groceries" was incomplete. After marking "Buy groceries" complete, QA Test Task's complete checkbox and edit button became enabled and label changed to "1 prerequisite completed".

Completed tasks ("Reply to client emails", "Buy groceries", "Organize desk" prior to deletion) remained visible under the "Completed" tab rather than being auto-removed; they only left when explicit Delete was invoked.

Opened Edit dialog for "Review project proposal" (which is a prerequisite of "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report"). The Prerequisites checklist only offered "QA Test Task", "Schedule dentist appointment", "Buy groceries", "Reply to client emails" - "Complete tax filing" and "Submit final report" were excluded from selectable options, preventing a circular dependency (B cannot be chosen as A's prerequisite if A is already B's prerequisite).

issue: Past deadline dates are accepted without restriction
actual: In the Create Task dialog, entering a past deadline date (2026-08-01, while today is 2026-09-02) did not disable the "Create Task" button nor show any validation error. Clicking "Create Task" successfully created the task, which then displayed "Overdue: Aug 1" on the card instead of being blocked at creation time.

evidence: "Create Task" button remains disabled (verified via DOM: disabled=true) when Title is empty or whitespace-only ("   "), preventing task creation without a title.

Deadline field is a native type="date" input. Typing alphabetic characters ("abcdefgh") is fully rejected, leaving the field empty with validity=true. Typing digit sequences is auto-structured into valid YYYY-MM-DD format by the browser's native date control, so malformed date strings cannot be entered.

When Title is empty/whitespace, the "Create Task" button is visibly disabled (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed, pointer-events-none via CSS classes "disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50"), providing clear visual feedback that the task cannot be submitted without a title.

issue: No details pop-up on general task hover
actual: Hovering over a task's card or its title (e.g. "Review project proposal", "Schedule dentist appointment", "Complete tax filing") produces no pop-up/tooltip at all. A pop-up ("Dependency Chain") only appears when hovering the specific small "Prerequisite ... incomplete" badge/icon on blocked tasks - this is the dependency-hover feature covered by IX-20, not a general "hover over the task shows details" feature.

evidence: Hovering over the "Prerequisite \"Review project proposal\" incomplete" badge on the "Complete tax filing" task card triggers a tooltip titled "Dependency Chain" listing "Review project proposal - pending", providing clear visual feedback for the dependency relationship.

Every task card on the main page shows the title (h3 heading), due date (e.g. "Sep 4", "Tomorrow", "Overdue: Aug 1"), and completion status - indicated both by tab placement (Active/Completed) and by the checkbox visual state (empty ring border for active vs. filled bg-primary checkmark for completed, verified via DOM class "bg-primary border-primary" on completed task checkboxes).
